result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on where you operate, how many employees you have, and whether you want payroll to integrate with your accounting software.

**If you're running a small business in Australia, I'd shortlist Xero, MYOB, Reckon and Payroller.** These are more relevant than popular US platforms such as Gusto or QuickBooks Payroll.

For most small Australian businesses, I'd start by comparing **Xero and MYOB** for an established accounting and payroll solution, or **Payroller** if keeping costs down is the priority.

## Best payroll software in Australia compared

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall for existing Xero users)

- Payroll integrated with accounting
- STP Phase 2 reporting
- Superannuation processing
- Employee payslips, leave and timesheets

Best if you want everything in one system.

Pricing: From \$37/month, depending on plan and employee limits.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for established small businesses)

- Payroll and accounting integration
- Employee onboarding
- STP reporting
- Superannuation management

A good alternative to Xero, particularly if your accountant already uses MYOB.

Pricing: Payroll-only plans from \$20/month for up to four employees, effective November 2026.

[MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Reckon Payroll**

(Best budget option)

- Straightforward payroll processing
- STP reporting
- Super calculations
- Leave and payslip management

Particularly attractive for businesses with one to four employees.

Pricing: \$16/month for up to four employees.

[Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/payroll-software/)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/v2DxdxtjjvEmcT175Hs6YVBjgbAAlKMZDR6USs-77ApdWW6sbAFow9cQJv_MT97jB9zjE3wPxOpKSO9gcLLxLfFypeZvyP5eJvDL5WGyfBsSIqIhU81GbrWMoq4pqjRGs2-V3Eb0qoi-t3xsMSUPgetkp-nB9-Vn5YkmqvxZsrEUOfyJgwiq9_ZT3tLhuZte?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Payroller**

(Best for micro businesses)

- Easy payroll processing
- Mobile app
- STP Phase 2
- Superannuation payments
- Employee self-service

A good option if you want simple payroll without paying for a large accounting package.

Pricing: From \$3.99 per employee/month on annual billing, subject to minimum charges and promotional terms.

[Payroller pricing](https://payroller.com.au/pricing/)

## My recommendation

Here's how I'd choose\:

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–4 employees, lowest cost | Reckon |
| Already using Xero | Xero Payroll |
| Already using MYOB | MYOB |
| Want simple mobile payroll | Payroller |
| Hospitality or retail with shifts | Employment Hero or Deputy |
| Growing business with complex HR | Employment Hero |


One important consideration in Australia: make sure your software supports STP Phase 2, superannuation payments and your employees' applicable Modern Awards. Payday Super also commenced on 1 July 2026, so check that the provider supports the new payment requirements. search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
